tags.description: Mendocino Coast Botanical Gardens contains manicured formal gardens, a dense coastal pine forest, fern-covered canyons, rhododendrons, dahlias, begonias, magnolias, conifers, heathers and more.

tags.note: The Gardens is non-smoking, and dog-friendly (leash required). The Garden Store and Nursery are open daily. Rhody's Garden Café is open seasonally from April through October. There is never an admission charge to shop or dine.
